title: Take a seat at the Crown
summary: The gaming suites now have usable chairs and animated table staff.
notes: Add four seats at blackjack, poker and baccarat, plus a chair at draw poker; sitting is free and wagers stay in the table controls.
Add dealers with idle, greeting, shuffle, deal, reveal, collection and payout animations, plus dice handling at craps.
Synchronize seat occupancy and dealer action timing for multiplayer and late arrivals.
